MAIN FEATURES
Your Experience Gets Better And Better Over Time.
Multitenancy
The multitenancy feature enables the individual database for each individual tenant.
Multilingual
Multilingual feature allows you to use Axiolance SaaS in your local language.
Single Page Application
It's a Single Page Application that doesn't need a page refresh which makes it faster.
Custom Domain
Customers can manage their domains change subdomains and add custom 2nd level domains.
Stripe Billing
Stripe already integrated. Tenants select billing plan  and can later change it in their dashboard.
CORE MODULES
Core Modules to Simplify and Grow Your Business
Customer Management
Customer Management is a crucial module that helps businesses effectively organize, track, and nurture their customer relationships.
Supplier Management
Supplier Management helps you keep track of all your vendors in one place. From storing contact details to monitoring transactions.
Employee Management
Employee Management centralizes your workforce data, from personal details to job roles, performance, and attendance.
Purchase Management
Purchase Management enables you to handle all procurement activities seamlessly. You can create purchase orders, track inventory levels.
Sales Management
Sales Management gives you full control over your sales pipeline. Track orders, view customer history, and generate invoices effortlessly.
Payments Management
Payments Management brings all your incoming and outgoing financial transactions into one organized space.
